Townhouse in Fair Oaks! 3 beds, 2.5 baths. Rent 2,260. HOA is paid by owner. Lease runs 6/1/27 to 5/31/28.
Pets considered case by case, dogs over 50 lbs need landlord approval and a $600 deposit. 
Utilities: Every 3 months the water bill averages $210. Electric budget billing $75, gas $30.
Yard has a 4 ft fence on three sides.
Parking: $95 per space per month for the second car.
Applicant screening fee $38 each.
